note_manual: Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops: Fig. 2 caption says the stack pressure was 'subsequently decreased to 5 MPa' but both branches have a marker at 2 MPa (Fig. 2a, Fig. S1); Table 1 'This work' row gives stack pressure 5–70 MPa (lowest plotted 2 MPa); Fig. S5 caption lists '350 MPa' while its legend (and the rest of the paper) uses 370 MPa; the text calls the carbon-electrode conductivity 'almost independent of the applied stack pressure' while Fig. 2a reads 1.72 → 3.01 mS/cm (2 → 70 MPa, increasing branch).
